concerns.text: Task T013 implements logic to 'log a warning but proceed' if the sample count is outside the 30–45 range. This directly violates FR-001 which mandates downloading 'ALL available spectra' to avoid selection bias. The task effectively allows the system to run with a biased, incomplete dataset, weakening the core requirement.

Task T031 instructs using 'observed effect size' to verify statistical power (SC-004). This creates circular logic (post-hoc power analysis) and fails to provide the prospective power validation required by SC-004, which measures against a minimum threshold of 0.8 for detecting a moderate correlation (|tau| ≥ 0.3).

Task T028 introduces a 'fallback to Tobit regression with L2 (Ridge) regularization' if VIF > 5. The spec (FR-005) requires a Tobit model or 'equivalent censored-data model' but does not authorize L2 regularization, which changes the likelihood function and coefficient interpretation. This is a silent relaxation of the methodological constraint.

Tasks T033, T035, and T036 implement critical functionality defined in FR-002 (handling low S/N as censored values) and SC-003 (detection limits) but are scoped to 'Review Response' (Phase 6). This creates a dependency where the core pipeline (US2) cannot be fully verified as compliant with FR-002 until the Review phase is complete, violating the independent testability of User Story 2.

Task T026 only computes and reports the '% CI width' without implementing the logic to validate this threshold against SC-003 (≤ 0.2 dex) or fail the pipeline if the criterion is not met. The acceptance criterion in the spec is not preserved in the task's verification step.
